markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (43%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Input is atypical, and InSitu and Invasive are nearly tied.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 43%, Invasive 41% | Near tie |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu, Invasive | Three classes unresolved |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.11 / 100th percentile | Input suspect [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu | Neighbors favor InSitu [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated [F4]
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 2, 5) · context · 94% neoplastic nuclei, top of reference range · Measured [F7]
- **Nuclear size** (regions 1, 2, 5) · context · Lowest mean nuclear area in reference set · Measured [F9]
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical, but failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable [F2]
- **Normal lobules** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable [F3]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 95% CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002); not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Input is out of distribution (reliability 0.11); probabilities may not transfer.
- Invasive is the true class; it trails InSitu by only two points.

## Check on the slide
1. **2, 5, 6** — Look for mitoses and necrosis; automated scores failed spot checks.
2. **7, 8, 11** — Confirm benign stroma or fat versus infiltrating tumor.
3. **1, 2, 5** — Dense tumor nuclei: judge duct-confined versus invasive growth.
